legal.question: A question about this page?
legal.privacyBody:
This page explains what this website collects and why. It is short because very little is collected.

## What I collect

- Your name, email and message when you send the contact form
- The picks you make on the project brief (kind and budget), so the contact form can show them
- Anonymous visit numbers from a privacy-friendly counter

## What I use it for

To reply to you and to plan the work you asked about. I do not sell personal data and I do not pass it to anyone who is not working on your project.

## How long I keep it

Messages are kept for as long as the conversation needs, and for the length of a project if one follows. You can ask me to delete them at any time.

## Your choices

You can ask for a copy of your data, ask me to correct it or ask me to delete it. Write to the email address at the bottom of this page and I will answer within a week.

## Other services

The links to code hosts and social profiles lead to services with their own policies. This page does not cover them.
legal.termsBody:
These are the terms for using this website and for the work it describes.

## This website

The case studies, articles and pictures here are mine unless marked otherwise. You are welcome to quote a short passage with a link back. Please ask before you reuse more than that.

## Code samples

Code shown in articles and in the lab is free to use in your own projects under the licence named on its page. It comes without a warranty.

## Project work

Paid work is agreed in writing. Scope, price, dates and ownership are set out in the proposal you sign, and that proposal comes first if it differs from this page.

## Numbers in case studies

Results are reported as measured at the time, on the devices and traffic described. They are not a promise for another product.

## Changes

These terms may change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
legal.cookiesBody:
This page lists what this website stores in your browser. There is not much of it.

## What is stored

- `sh-brief`: the kind, budget and name you pick on the project brief, so the contact form can show them. Removed when you send the form
- `sh-sent`: your first name, so the thank-you page can greet you
- `sh-loaded`: a flag that plays the opening line once per visit

All three live in session storage. They are never sent to a server and they are gone when you close the tab.

## What is not stored

No advertising cookies and no cross-site tracking are set by this website.

## Analytics

An anonymous visit counter runs on this site. It does not identify you.

## How to switch it off

You can clear or block site data in your browser settings. The site keeps working; the opening line simply plays again.
